description: Plan imposition for a booklet or book. Pass `pages` (1 to 1024) and `binding`: saddle (stitched; one nested stack, pages in multiples of 4), perfect or sewn (gathered signatures of `signature` pages: 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64; 16 is the common offset size). Returns pages after padding to the next multiple, blank pages to add, number of signatures or sheets, and for saddle the printer-spread pairs for every sheet (outer and inner sides). With `caliper_microns` it estimates creep for saddle stitch: the sheet nested k sheets inside the outermost shifts its content outward by about k x caliper, so planned inward compensation for the outermost sheet is about (sheets - 1) x caliper. Printers use their own creep tables, and some compensate with 2 x caliper; treat this as an estimate.

caliper_microns.description: Thickness of one sheet in microns (for creep)

pages.description: Page count (total, including covers if self-cover)
